title: 去车站接贵客  (Off to the Station Platform)

segments.t: At half past two under the stone archway of the front gate, Qing hands a crisp cream welcome sign bearing an eight-point compass rose to Hao and Peng. Listen first.
两位先生，接站牌拿好：欢迎回到八号房和九号房！
快看，哥——小晴连角落里那个八向罗盘星都画得一模一样！
火车二十分钟后停靠三号站台，弟，走去车站要十二分钟。
十年前大学大教室那么多人，老师还认得清我吗？
开什么玩笑，志豪？你一秒钟之内就认出了他那个小墨星！
再说，老师永远不会忘记那个在笔记本里量遍每个房间的安静学生。
到了站台帮老师拎行李箱，再打辆出租车直接回客栈！
周经理来得及约梧桐巷的邻居三点半过来吗？
十六位邻居已经答应啦，十号院那位现在正给小提琴调音呢！
钢琴旁边给我们留两个位子——走啦，志豪，眼睛朝前，不走近道！
今天绝对不钻周经理那些小巷子——沿着梧桐巷直奔中央车站！
三点出租车一到门口，记得把门铃摇两下！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
两位先生，接站牌拿好：欢迎回到八号房和九号房！

'Here is your station pickup sign, gentlemen: Welcome back to Room Eight and Room Nine!' "Jiezhanpai" names a "station pickup sign", and "nahao" adds "hao" after "na" ("hold") to mean "hold it securely".
快看，哥——小晴连角落里那个八向罗盘星都画得一模一样！

'Look, big brother—Qing even drew that exact eight-point compass rose in the corner!' Calling Peng "ge" ("older brother") keeps family warmth, and "yimoyiyang" is the lively four-character way to say "identical".
火车二十分钟后停靠三号站台，弟，走去车站要十二分钟。

'The train pulls into platform three in twenty minutes, little brother, and walking to the station takes twelve.' "Tingkao" specifically means a train or boat "pulling in to stop" at "sanhao zhantai" ("platform three").
十年前大学大教室那么多人，老师还认得清我吗？

'With so many people in a big university lecture hall ten years ago, will he even remember me?' "Rendeqing" links "recognize" with "clearly" using "de" to ask whether Hao's face will stand out clearly in memory.
开什么玩笑，志豪？你一秒钟之内就认出了他那个小墨星！
'Are you kidding, Hao? You spotted his tiny ink star in under a second!' "Kai shenme wanxiao" challenges doubt with "what kind of joke are you making?"—just like "are you kidding?" in English.
再说，老师永远不会忘记那个在笔记本里量遍每个房间的安静学生。

'Besides, teachers never forget the quiet student who measured every single room in his notebook.' "Zaishuo" smoothly bridges to a second point ("besides"), while "liang bian" pairs "measure" with "all over".
到了站台帮老师拎行李箱，再打辆出租车直接回客栈！

'Help him carry his suitcase from the platform, then grab a taxi straight back to the inn!' "Lin" means carrying something by a handle in one hand, and "da liang chuzuche" uses "da" ("catch/hail") with the vehicle counter "liang".
周经理来得及约梧桐巷的邻居三点半过来吗？
'Did Manager Zhou manage to invite the Wutong Lane neighbors over for half past three?' "Laideji" means "have enough time to" or "make it in time", paired with "yue" for inviting people over.
十六位邻居已经答应啦，十号院那位现在正给小提琴调音呢！

'Sixteen neighbors already said yes, and the neighbor from number ten is tuning his violin right now!' "Wei" counts guests and neighbors politely instead of plain "ge", and "tiaoyin" combines "adjust" and "pitch" for "tuning an instrument".
钢琴旁边给我们留两个位子——走啦，志豪，眼睛朝前，不走近道！
'Save two seats near the piano for us—come on, Hao, eyes forward, and no shortcuts!' "Liu" means "keep" or "save" a seat, while "zou jindao" means "taking a shortcut".
今天绝对不钻周经理那些小巷子——沿着梧桐巷直奔中央车站！

'Definitely no diving into Zhou's little side alleys today—straight down Wutong Lane to Central Station!' "Zuan" captures squeezing or ducking into narrow lanes, and "zhiben" means "heading straight for" a destination.
三点出租车一到门口，记得把门铃摇两下！

'As soon as your taxi pulls up at three, remember to ring the gate bell twice!' Using "yi ..." right before "dao" sets up "the moment your taxi arrives", and "yao liang xia" tells them to give the bell two shakes.
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
两位先生，接站牌拿好：欢迎回到八号房和九号房！
快看，哥——小晴连角落里那个八向罗盘星都画得一模一样！
火车二十分钟后停靠三号站台，弟，走去车站要十二分钟。

开什么玩笑，志豪？你一秒钟之内就认出了他那个小墨星！
再说，老师永远不会忘记那个在笔记本里量遍每个房间的安静学生。
到了站台帮老师拎行李箱，再打辆出租车直接回客栈！
周经理来得及约梧桐巷的邻居三点半过来吗？
十六位邻居已经答应啦，十号院那位现在正给小提琴调音呢！
钢琴旁边给我们留两个位子——走啦，志豪，眼睛朝前，不走近道！
今天绝对不钻周经理那些小巷子——沿着梧桐巷直奔中央车站！
三点出租车一到门口，记得把门铃摇两下！
Two brothers stride side by side down Wutong Lane toward Central Station while Courtyard Inn prepares its warmest welcome. One final scene for Episode Five!
